shortBio.en: Red Hot Chili Peppers bass; slap/pop funk-punk low end as the band’s constant engine.
shortBio.zh: Red Hot Chili Peppers 贝斯；slap/pop funk-punk 低频即乐队恒定引擎。

whyHub.en: Bass as logo: guitarists rotate (Slovak, Navarro, Frusciante eras); Flea’s pocket and slap attack stay.
whyHub.zh: 贝斯即 logo：吉他手轮换（Slovak、Navarro、Frusciante 时期）；Flea 的 pocket 与 slap 攻击不变。

body.en:
Born 1962. Co-founds RHCP with Kiedis. Early records hitch punk tempo to funk slap; Blood Sugar Sex Magik (1991) with Frusciante is the mass citation. Navarro mid-90s, Frusciante returns, later Josh Klinghoffer, Frusciante again—bass chair does not rebrand.

Hub: institutional continuity through guitar churn; melodic high-register bass lines as character.
body.zh:
1962 年生。与 Kiedis 共创 RHCP。早期专集把朋克速度挂上 funk slap；与 Frusciante 的 Blood Sugar Sex Magik（1991）是大众引用。90 年代中 Navarro、Frusciante 回归、后 Josh Klinghoffer、再 Frusciante——贝斯席不换品牌。

枢纽：吉他动荡中的制度连续；高音区旋律贝斯线即角色。

note.en: Founding bass through every major guitar era.
note.zh: 创始贝斯，贯穿各主要吉他时代。
